query: Latest IBRiS poll for Rzeczpospolita (rp.pl) parliamentary voting intention Poland July 2026 and August 2026. What are the most recent KO and PiS support figures, and fieldwork dates? Specifically the 'gdyby wybory' Sejm poll.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

**The most recent IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita Sejm poll was fielded 24–25 July 2026** (CATI, n=1,000; published ~27 July 2026) — this is the newest as of today (27 July 2026); no August 2026 poll exists yet.

**Headline result: KO 30.1% (186 seats) vs PiS 17.3% (98 seats).**

**Important correction on your brief:** The "late-July PiS 28.7%" figure could not be verified. The confirmed IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita late-July poll shows **PiS at 17.3%**, not 28.7% — because it was fielded during the PiS split, with Mateusz Morawiecki's new "Rozwój Plus" counted separately (7.4%), drawing ~6pp away from PiS. Your **KO 30.1% matches exactly**; only the PiS number diverges.

**Trajectory (KO vs PiS):**
- Late May 2026: KO 30.9% / PiS 25.4%
- Early July (2–3 Jul): KO 29.1% (168 seats) / PiS ~23.2%
- Late July (24–25 Jul): KO 30.1% (186 seats) / PiS 17.3% (98 seats), Rozwój Plus 7.4% new

**Cadence:** Roughly monthly, typically Wednesday publication with two-day fieldwork; the late-July poll was an off-cycle addition triggered by the PiS split.

One caution flagged in my report: a **separate United Surveys by IBRiS poll for Wirtualna Polska** (same 24–25 July dates but different client) showed KO 29.4%/PiS 21.5% without Morawiecki, or KO 28.5%/PiS 15.9% with Rozwój Plus — these should not be confused with the rp.pl series.

key_facts: Most recent IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita Sejm voting-intention poll: fieldwork 24–25 July 2026, published ~27 July 2026 (CATI, n=1,000).
24–25 July IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita result: KO 30.1% (186 seats), PiS 17.3% (98 seats) — fielded during the PiS/Morawiecki split with Rozwój Plus counted separately at 7.4%.
The caller's 'late-July PiS 28.7%' could not be confirmed; verified IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita late-July PiS figure is 17.3%. KO 30.1% matches.
PiS fell ~6.0pp vs early July because Morawiecki's Rozwój Plus (7.4%, ~30 seats) drew away former PiS voters.
Early July IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita (2–3 July 2026): KO 29.1% (168 seats) vs PiS ~23.2%.
Late May 2026 IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita: KO 30.9% vs PiS 25.4% (baseline confirmed by RMF24).
Full 24–25 July field: KO 30.1, PiS 17.3, Konfederacja 12.3, KKP/Braun 10.9, Rozwój Plus 7.4, Lewica 7.0, PSL 2.8, Razem 1.6, Polska 2050 0.5.
Declared turnout dropped to ~51.4% (from ~60.4% in early July).
No August 2026 IBRiS/Rzeczpospolita poll had been published as of 27 July 2026; 24–25 July is the newest.
Cadence: roughly monthly, typically Wednesday publication with two-day fieldwork; late-July poll was off-cycle due to the PiS split.

Separate United Surveys by IBRiS/Wirtualna Polska poll (same 24–25 July dates, different client): KO 29.4%/PiS 21.5% without Morawiecki; KO 28.5%/PiS 15.9% with Rozwój Plus 7.5% — do not confuse with rp.pl series.
